summary: All requested requirements (REQ-13 through REQ-19) appear to be implemented in the diff. The colorCode field has been added to the backend data model with migration support, frontend forms include the color code input, the inventory table displays a Color Code column, and a comprehensive bill generation system has been implemented with backend function, frontend button, and professional invoice component.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) to migrate old SemenStraw records without colorCode to new records with colorCode defaulting to 'unknown'
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention data migration or handling of existing records. The migration.mo file and migration logic in main.mo were not requested.
